sections.Profile:
"Arena" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in June 1987 as part of the Gottlieb System 80B series. It features two flippers, one ramp, and a three-ball multiball mode, offering a competitive gameplay experience. Designed by Ray Tanzer with artwork by Constantino and Jeanine Mitchell, it was produced in a limited run of 3,099 units.
